name: Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State
benefit: After admission in all Government and Non-Government schools of the state, children from Class 1 to 8 receive free education, meals, books, and shoe-bags.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant (child) must be 6 years old to get admission in Class 1. 1. The applicant (student) must be currently registered in Anganwadi Bal Vatika to be eligible for admission to Class 1.
